name: Tier 0 zero-cost program
purpose: Close the empirical-rigor objections for an ICLR 2027 submission without spending API budget, by replaying optimizers against already-enumerated landscapes.

conventions.charging: distinct evaluated permutations; repeats served from cache and not charged
conventions.reference_method: uniform sampling without replacement at equal total budget
conventions.optima: exact, from full enumeration, not best-observed proxies
conventions.decisive: one method's Wilson lower bound exceeds the other's Wilson upper bound

hypotheses.claim: On landscapes whose pre-flight regime call is 'search pays' (operator-aligned FDC <= -0.15), at least one structured search method beats uniform sampling decisively at budget 100.
hypotheses.threshold: Wilson lower bound of some method > Wilson upper bound of uniform, success@100
hypotheses.falsified_if: no method achieves this on any landscape called 'search pays'
hypotheses.reversal_consequence: The decision band does not identify landscapes where search pays; the rule needs re-derivation, not re-description.

hypotheses.claim: On the exhaustive LLM instruction-ordering landscape, no method beats uniform sampling decisively at budget 50 -- the published 'PRISM approximately equals random' result survives a full 13-method gauntlet.
hypotheses.threshold: no method's Wilson lower bound on success@50 exceeds uniform's Wilson upper bound
hypotheses.note: This hypothesis predicts a NEGATIVE result and is registered deliberately. The paper's argument is that the protocol forecasts its own failures.
hypotheses.reversal_consequence: A method that decisively beats random on this landscape would be a stronger result than the null and would be reported as the headline.

hypotheses.claim: The precedence-pair surrogate is among the two strongest non-uniform methods on precedence-structured landscapes, replicating Iteration 12 (kendall n=7 reached in ~13.5 evaluations against 55.7 for elitist).
hypotheses.threshold: top-2 by mean evaluations-to-first-optimum on kendall_n7

hypotheses.claim: Charging the pre-flight probe to the budget does not sink the protocol: prism_protocol stays within 10 percentage points of uniform's success@100 on every landscape.
hypotheses.threshold: 10 percentage points of success rate at budget 100
hypotheses.falsified_if: prism_protocol falls more than 10pp below uniform on any landscape
hypotheses.reversal_consequence: The pre-flight is too expensive at small budgets; the paper must state the budget below which the protocol should not be run.

hypotheses.claim: Regime-call accuracy against the full-enumeration truth rises with probe size m and reaches at least 90% at m=200 on landscapes whose |FDC - threshold| >= 0.10.
hypotheses.threshold: 0.90 accuracy at m=200 on clear-margin landscapes
hypotheses.falsified_if: accuracy at m=200 is below 0.90 on such landscapes

hypotheses.claim: Operator selection by argmax rho1 agrees with the full-enumeration argmax at least 90% of the time once m >= 100 pairs, on typed synthetic landscapes.
hypotheses.falsified_if: agreement below 0.90 at m=100 on typed synthetics

hypotheses.claim: The LLM landscape's regime call is unstable below 16 questions: agreement with the full 32-question call drops below 80% at q=8.
hypotheses.falsified_if: agreement at q=8 remains at or above 0.80
hypotheses.reversal_consequence: If the call is stable even at q=8, the resolution objection is weaker than assumed and the paid resolution upgrade (E1) is less urgent.
